{{Quote|Admiral Valan, you are now in command of this fleet. It is now your job to put an end to Stazi.|[[Darth Azard]]|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
The '''Outer Rim Third Fleet''' was one of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] in [[137 ABY]].

==History==
[[File:Outer_Rim_Third_Fleet_strikes_back.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Outer Rim Third Fleet attempts to prevent the [[Evacuation of Dac]].]]
Composed of at least nine [[Ardent-class fast frigate|Imperial fast frigates]] and seven [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyers]], including the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Relentless (Pellaeon-class)|''Relentless'']], this battle fleet was tasked with eliminating [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].

It was under of the command of Admiral [[Sha Dun]], a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]]. In light of his failure to capture Admiral Stazi, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azard]] killed Dun, replacing him with Admiral [[Dru Valan|Valan]]. Valan planned a trap over [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], which became the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]]. This battle was a complete failure for the Third Fleet, which not only allowed the Remnant to escape with the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], but also destroyed a third of the Mon Calamari docks. After the defeat, Admiral Valan apparently committed suicide.

After [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] ordered the [[Final Protocol|elimination]] of all life on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], the Outer Rim Third Fleet was sent to prevent the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and its allies from [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuating]] the planet's population. Under the command of [[Darth Stryfe]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Geist (Moff)|Geist]] and Admiral [[Krion Grail]], the Outer Rim Third Fleet was unable to contain the evacuation and suffered heavy damage at the fire of the Alliance and the [[Empire-in-exile|Fel-loyalist]] fleet commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]]. At the behest of Geist, Lord Stryfe accepted to withdraw.
